limitations.text: The candidate captions follow source labels; this research did not inspect either image’s pixels. Independent visual review is needed before treating their apparent strokes or component shapes as confirmed.
The source labels do not settle whether the bronze component is 凡, 舟, or a tray-like form; the modern redraws do not independently establish that graphic relationship.
